dispositions.name: BuyLead created
dispositions.hint: Buyer still wants it AND gave the requirement (at least quantity and what exactly they need, plus location or timeline), so a verified BuyLead can be created

dispositions.name: Partial details
dispositions.hint: Buyer talked but key details (quantity, specification, location, timeline) are still missing

dispositions.name: Callback requested
dispositions.hint: Buyer is busy and asked to be called back later

dispositions.name: Not interested
dispositions.hint: Buyer no longer needs it, refuses, or asks not to be called

dispositions.name: No conversation
dispositions.hint: Voicemail, silence, wrong number, line cut at once

dispositions.name: Other / unclear
dispositions.hint: They talked, but none of the above fits, or you cannot tell

flags.name: Bot made a mistake
flags.hint: looped, hallucinated, misheard badly or wrote down wrong details

note: VANI BuyLead qualification: the seller is unavailable, VANI calls the buyer and captures Quantity, Specification, Delivery location and Timeline so the lead is not lost. Add a disposition by adding it here and adding cue words in rules.json. Any disposition can be a test goal.

bot_issues.repeated_question: bot asked again something the buyer already answered
bot_issues.ignored_answer: bot did not use or acknowledge what the buyer said
bot_issues.wrong_detail_recorded: bot repeated back or implied a detail different from what the buyer said
bot_issues.misheard_product_or_number: speech recognition clearly misunderstood a product, quantity or city
bot_issues.hallucinated_info: bot stated facts or promises it could not know (price, stock, seller details)
bot_issues.did_not_confirm_details: no read-back of the captured details at the end
bot_issues.abrupt_end: bot ended while the buyer was still talking or before capturing the details
bot_issues.language_mismatch: bot kept a language the buyer struggled with
bot_issues.too_verbose: long bot turns that lost the buyer's patience

fatal.buylead_fatal: the captured BuyLead data would be wrong or corrupt
fatal.oncall_fatal: the bot flow broke down: looped, hallucinated or ended abruptly
